description_en: Imports the public key portion of an RSA key pair generated by another tool
description_zh: 导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone import-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --public-key-body ABC1234567 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The public key content of the key pair
parameters.name: public_key_body

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The public key fingerprint format is defined in RFC 4716 and uses the MD5 message digest algorithm
KeyPairFingerPrint.description_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair
